jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description:
About Collective:

Collective is on a mission to redefine the way businesses-of-one work. Our technology and team of trusted advisors help members achieve financial independence by taking care of everything from business incorporation to accounting, bookkeeping, tax services, and access to a thriving community, all in one integrated platform. We believe in empowering self-employed people to enjoy the same tax savings that big companies get, so they can focus on their passion, not paperwork.

Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher and Guy Oseary), QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft.

About the role:

We're seeking a Product Lead to drive execution, and directly shape customer and business outcomes across Collective’s financial platform. You won't just optimize existing systems—you will lead critical core product areas and lead the expansion into high-growth, potential new product verticals that will define the future of our financial operating system.

What you'll do: 

 - Own the product area vision, strategy, implementation, and customer & business outcomes for your core product areas.

 - Work closely with AI engineers and subject matter experts to bring to life AI-driven product experiences - for example: intelligent automation using LLMs and agentic systems.

 - Work with operational teams to ensure they have the tools and workflows to be effective, determining where product automation & AI can unlock efficiencies.

 - Lead and inspire an XFN team to ship innovative experiences.

 - Deeply understand business and product performance to ensure the team is focused on the highest leverage opportunities that balance long term growth with immediate business needs.

 - Manage the roadmap and team processes to enhance quality and velocity of execution, make tradeoff decisions between business priorities and available resources.

 - Drive effective partnership both cross-functionally, across product teams, and external partners to ensure strong business outcomes.

 - Define the framework and metrics to measure the impact of the team; deeply understand core drivers and monitor progress.

What you'll bring:

 - 5-6+ years of product management experience with a deep understanding of the product lifecycle.

 - Strong domain expertise and foundational systems thinking (or operations-adjacent expertise), understanding day-to-day operational considerations and implications of execution.

 - An 'owner' and 'driver' mindset – biased toward action and getting things done.

 - Drive for simplicity & elegance – finding elegant, simplifying solutions to complex challenges.

 - A high-quality bar for contributions.

 - Comfort & skill with ambiguity - solving ambiguous problems with first principles and structured thinking.

 - Strong written and verbal communication.

 - Fluency with data and experience working on data-heavy or ML/AI products.

 - Intellectual curiosity & humility. 

What we offer:

 - Hybrid Work Model: Based in San Francisco with a balance of in-office and remote flexibility.

 - Fresh Lunch: Provided on in-office days.

 - Commuter Support: $150 monthly reimbursement for transit expenses.

 - Health & Wellness: $200 quarterly reimbursement to support your well-being.

 - Time Off: Flexible PTO plus 14 company holidays.

 - Comprehensive Coverage: 100% medical, dental, and vision for employees; 75% coverage for dependents.

 - Parental Leave: 16 weeks fully paid.

 - Retirement & Ownership: 401k plan plus an equity package.

 - Team Connection: Quarterly virtual events and an annual in-person summit.

jobs.description:
About Collective:

Collective is on a mission to redefine the way businesses-of-one work. Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher and Guy Oseary), QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft.

About the role:

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and gritty Product Lead to join our growing Product team. At Collective we are building first-of-its-kind, category-defining AI-enabled financial back-office to help millions of solopreneurs to start and run their businesses more effectively. We are looking for a Product Lead to drive Growth at Collective. 

As the Growth Product Lead, you will set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution across key growth surfaces. You’ll lead work across onboarding, activation, conversion, referral, and sales-assisted product experiences, helping define how product drives scalable revenue over time. You’ll bring structured thinking to ambiguous problems, use strong product judgment and analytical rigor to make decisions, and work hands-on with cross-functional partners to turn ideas into high-quality execution quickly.

What you'll do: 

 - Own the product area vision, strategy, implementation, and customer & business outcomes for Growth & Monetization

 - Own the strategy and execution of member value realization, helping members clearly understand and quantify the financial outcomes Collective delivers to drive activation, retention, referrals, and revenue growth.

 - Grow Collective’s customer base through innovative product-led growth experiences (e.g. referrals, multi-user product experiences, community features and more)

 - Work closely with VP of Sales & Marketing to run sales/ funnel optimization experiments

 - Lead and inspire an XFN team to ship innovative experiences

 - Deeply understand business and product performance to ensure the team is focused on the highest leverage opportunities that balance long term growth with immediate business needs

 - Manage the roadmap and team processes to enhance quality and velocity of execution, make tradeoff decisions between business priorities and available resources

 - Drive effective partnership both cross-functionally, across product teams, and external partners to ensure the team is effectively strong business outcomes

 - Define the framework and metrics to measure the impact of the team; deeply understand the core drivers and monitor progress

What you'll bring:

 - 6-8+ years of product management. You have a deep understanding of the product craft throughout the entire product lifecycle - delivering successful & innovative products

 - Growth product expertise. You deeply understand Growth products, including how to build seamless experiences to drive conversion, re-imagining referral programs, and building features throughout the product lifecycle to drive customer-led growth. You understand deeply how to enable our customers to become net promoters & referrers of the product, and how to incentivize them to keep driving growth.

 - Fluency with experimentation and data. You are very comfortable defining experiments e.g A/B tests, fake door tests, and more. You know how to leverage data to make product decisions rapidly & insightfully.

 - An “owner” / “driver” mindset. You are biased toward action and get stuff done. No task is too big or too small for you. You strive to solve problems independently, while striking the balance of asking for help.

 - Drive for simplicity and elegance. Ability to take on complex product challenges and find elegant, simplifying solutions to avoid making them our customers’ and partner’s problems.

 - A high quality bar. For your own contributions and those of the people around you

 - Comfort & skill with ambiguity. Ability to independently solve ambiguous problems with - first principles and structured thinking.

What we offer:

 - Hybrid Work Model: Based in San Francisco with a balance of in-office and remote flexibility.

 - Fresh Lunch: Provided on in-office days.

 - Commuter Support: $150 monthly reimbursement for transit expenses.

 - Health & Wellness: $200 quarterly reimbursement to support your well-being.

 - Time Off: Flexible PTO plus 14 company holidays.

 - Comprehensive Coverage: 100% medical, dental, and vision for employees; 75% coverage for dependents.

 - Parental Leave: 16 weeks fully paid.

 - Retirement & Ownership: 401k plan plus an equity package.

 - Team Connection: Quarterly virtual events and an annual in-person summit.
